subject: Marketplace addendum: seller-proxy & attribution language sync
messages:
From: Rachel Summers <rachel@cloudbridge.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Marketplace addendum: attribution and seller-proxy clause

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the call yesterday. Attached is our next pass (CloudBridge_Marketplace_Addendum_v3_redlines.docx) with marketplace-specific pass-through language and some proposed attribution text for how the listing and invoicing should reference CloudBridge vs Redwood. Key asks from our side:

- Can Redwood accept a seller-proxy model for marketplace listings (CloudBridge remains the billed customer, Redwood appears as the seller on the marketplace tile)?
- We need clarity on pass-through attribution in the Order Form: buyer-facing invoice text + revenue recognition flags for our finance team.
- Audit evidence: our compliance team requests a short description of the evidence Redwood will provide for usage metering (logs, metered events, dated CSV export).

We put redlines in the attached doc. If possible, please loop in legal and ops to confirm feasibility and suggest alternative language if any of the ask is a hard no.

We'd like to get to an execution-ready addendum this week; is a 30-min sync tomorrow afternoon possible? I'll include marketplace-legal on any follow-ups.

Thanks,

Rachel Summers
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
CloudBridge Inc.
--
Attachment: CloudBridge_Marketplace_Addendum_v3_redlines.docx (docx, 98 KB)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Summers <rachel@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum: attribution and seller-proxy clause

Rachel — appreciate the clear redlines. Looping in a few folks here: Ben (sales) and Karthik (legal) to confirm contract language and ops implications.

Quick notes before legal dives in:
- Seller-proxy: we can list Redwood as the seller of record on the marketplace tile, but finance will need a pass-through invoice mapping so CloudBridge gets consolidated usage data for your buyers.
- Attribution: we prefer the Order Form to include both an internal "billing owner" field and a public-facing seller name so reporting and support ownership are clear.
- Audit evidence: we'll propose a standard extract (daily CSV + monthly snapshot) but need product to confirm retention windows.

Ben / Karthik — can you review the attached redlines and propose any non-starters? If we agree on language today we can send a DocuSign packet to CloudBridge by EOD.

I can do a 30-min call tomorrow (Wed) 2:00–4:00pm PT — what works for you, Rachel?

Best,

Grace O'Connor
Partnerships Lead | Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0198

Attachment referenced: CloudBridge_Marketplace_Addendum_v3_redlines.docx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 13:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum: attribution and seller-proxy clause

Grace / team — my initial read attached (redwood_proposed_language.txt). High-level comments inline:

1) Seller-of-record / seller-proxy: we can accept language that designates Redwood as the seller-of-record on the marketplace listing provided CloudBridge agrees to (a) indemnify Redwood for buyer-side claims arising from the marketplace listing and (b) provide transaction-level purchase metadata on request. Proposed compromise language: Redwood will be listed as the "seller" on the marketplace and will invoice CloudBridge; CloudBridge will remain the contracting party with end-customers and will indemnify Redwood for buyer-directed claims.

2) Pass-through attribution & billing text: suggest two fields in the Order Form: (i) "Marketplace Seller Display Name" (public-facing), and (ii) "Billing Owner (for invoice and revenue allocation)" (internal only). We should make explicit that the Billing Owner governs finance/routing and reporting.

3) Audit evidence: recommend we commit to providing a dated, signed CSV extract monthly with a 12-month retention as a standard; anything longer is ops-heavy and requires a separate SOW. We can add a short clause that allows CloudBridge to request additional extracts for audit with reasonable notice and cost reimbursement.

4) Indemnity cap: CloudBridge is asking for limited liability — we should try to cap Redwood liability to standard amounts and push back on unlimited transfer of risk. Propose mutual cap at the greater of $1M or 12 months' fees.

5) Signature flow: prefer DocuSign and can prepare a clean copy once language is agreed.

I've attached the suggested language and marked non-starters. Ben, please confirm whether the seller-proxy model triggers any commercial changes (commissions / partner crediting). Laura, can procurement confirm if this requires order-form metadata fields we don't currently capture?

-Karthik

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
--
Attachment: redwood_proposed_language.txt (text, 6 KB)

From: Rachel Summers <rachel@cloudbridge.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: marketplace-legal@cloudbridge.com, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 15:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum: attribution and seller-proxy clause

Karthik / Grace — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the proposed language. A few responses:

- Indemnity: CloudBridge cannot accept an open-ended indemnity for routine marketplace buyer disputes. We can accept a carveout for buyer fraud/sales misrepresentation, and we agree to indemnify Redwood for claims arising solely from content CloudBridge publishes to the marketplace. We will not assume liability for platform-level outages.

- Liability cap: we can meet in the middle on a liability cap of $2M or 18 months' fees (whichever is greater).

- Audit evidence: the monthly dated CSV extract with 12-month retention is acceptable. We will route audit requests via our procurement contact and agree to reasonable reimbursement for extraordinary extraction requests.

- Signature: please send a clean final and we'll execute. I've attached our final package (Marketplace_Addendum_v4_for_signature.docx) and added a DocuSign envelope link to streamline execution: https://app.docusign.com/sign/ABCDEFG12345

Tomorrow at 3:00pm PT would work for a quick sync if you want to go through any last items before we sign.

Appreciate the collaboration — looking forward to getting this live.

Rachel Summers
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
CloudBridge Inc.
